We have reviewed your proposal and the referenced quality scorecard; however, our overall performance remains strong and this does not warrant a price reduction. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our current Angebot is a price of €374.07 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Thank you for your offer. To go ahead we propose the attached terms: unit price EUR 5.31, index clause None, payment days 90, contract months 24. We look forward to your confirmation. We offer a 24-month commitment at unchanged annual volume; please reflect that commitment in your price, with payment priced as part of the package. This is a conditional exchange: we can commit to this package in return for the proposed unit price.

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract and can accommodate the requested 90-day payment terms. Please note that we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month period, which is why we must include an AS-14404 index clause. 

For our current offer, we can propose a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Under these conditions, we can offer a unit price of EUR 5.57; furthermore, please provide the exact figures for your anticipated annual volume so we can properly evaluate your commitment. Which volume can you commit to? 

Alternatively, we can present an alternative package at a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
